body:
> Nice feature!
>
> There's no tests of the `infiniteHits` widget using the `cache` option, but only a unit test for `createInfiniteHitsSessionStorageCache`, which is a specific implementation of the cache.
>
> In order to test the widget in a closer way of a user implementation, can we add a higher-level test for `infiniteHits` with a manual implementation of `cache`?

@francoischalifour thanks for the feedback. What kind of test are you expecting? Tests on widget level? or e2e test?
I didn't particularly add widget-level tests, because anyway I have to mock either sessionStorage or localStorage, then it becomes almost the same as the in-memory cache implementation.

Maybe I can write a test where I provide a cache to an InfiniteHits instance, and take the cache and create another InfiniteHits instance with the cache to see if it properly renders all the hits without search request. What do you think?
